name: Sanctuary

components.m: a shard of glass from a mirror

summary: Ward a creature: anyone targeting it with an attack or damaging spell must pass a Wisdom save or pick another target.
text: Ward one creature within range for 1 minute. Whenever a creature targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell, the attacker makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. The ward doesn't protect against areas of effect. The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell or deals damage.
